claims.summary: The retained GPT-5.4 Mini World Literature project recovers from four failed material families to 9/9 and 99/A without its original API key.
All missing standard compiler families rebuild together from one current blueprint with a hard zero-provider allowance.
Finalizer retry accounting uses observed generation results, so four local actions report zero provider calls rather than four estimated calls.
A successful local compile replaces stale compiler-failure provenance with the four-material recovery receipt.
Legacy assignment bodies receive the current idempotent title-compaction repair while preserving title and Related Lessons identity.
The real browser reaches one green ZIP action and downloads a valid 79-entry archive with 10/10 readiness and 38/38 export verification.
The recovery behavior stays within the existing landing, Living Course Compiler, AppFlow, and compiler bundle ceilings.
Shared compiler and finalizer improvements benefit compatible providers while Gemma weights and adapter activation remain unchanged.
